stepExplanation:
Using sin θc = n₂/n₁ with n₁ = 1.33 (water) and n₂ = 1.00 (air):
$$\sin\theta_c = \frac{1.00}{1.33} = 0.752$$
$$\theta_c = \sin^{-1}(0.752) = 48.8°$$
For any angle greater than 48.8°, total internal reflection occurs.
stepBody: Using sin θc = n₂/n₁, calculate the critical angle. Given: n_water = 1.33, n_air = 1.00. Give your answer in degrees.
